# Control map

<!-- Generated by tools/governance.py --write; edit control-registry.json. -->

Owner: maintainer. Status: implemented control inventory, not a test-run report.
Review on changed standards, mechanisms, evidence or coverage. The
[registry](control-registry.json) owns these mappings; [engineering](engineering.md)
owns mandatory wording and [charter](charter.md) owns principles.

Automatic controls run in the common lane. Runtime controls act in the live system;
their tests cover only the stated cases. Manual controls require the named review
or probe. Implementation and evidence links do not assert a current execution or pass.

## Mechanisms and coverage

### C-PORTABLE — Portable regression lane (automatic)

Controller, HTTP adapter, setup and spectator regressions. Common command compiles Python, runs selected Ruff correctness diagnostics, Import Linter contracts, JavaScript syntax checks, Python tests and delayed-image viewer tests; markdown-it-py parses document links/images before contained file-target checks; diff whitespace is checked.

Owner: maintainer. Trigger: each integration checkpoint and configured CI event.
Enforcement: Invoked by common command, opt-in local hook and CI recipe; hook can be bypassed and no hosted required check is configured.
Failure response: Preserve failure output, fix the cause and rerun before claiming portable acceptance.

Evidence / implementation: [tools/check.py](../tools/check.py), [tests/test_controller.py](../tests/test_controller.py), [tests/test_server.py](../tests/test_server.py), [tests/test_setup.py](../tests/test_setup.py), [tests/test_viewer.cjs](../tests/test_viewer.cjs), [.github/workflows/check.yml](../.github/workflows/check.yml), [.githooks/pre-commit](../.githooks/pre-commit), [pyproject.toml](../pyproject.toml), [requirements-dev.lock](../requirements-dev.lock), [tests/test_devtools.py](../tests/test_devtools.py).

Coverage gap: Fake bridge tests do not execute CDDA. Loopback tests require bind permission; missing Node or dev tools and denied binds fail the lane. Markdown link/image targets are checked, excluding anchors, external availability and raw HTML links. Ruff selects E9/F63/F7/F82, not comprehensive formatting or typing.

### C-RUNTIME — Live authority and input guards (runtime)

Single-controller dispatch, HTTP trust boundary and spectator input freshness. Controller validates authority, bounds inputs, serializes dispatch and freezes uncertain outcomes; server validates origin/token and frame paths; viewer waits for matching image decode.

Owner: controller and viewer maintainer. Trigger: every relevant request, observation and image decode.
Enforcement: Implemented at runtime; regression execution is C-PORTABLE. Source references alone establish no behavioral pass.
Failure response: Reject or freeze further dispatch; expose error and reconcile by observation before explicit resume.

Evidence / implementation: [harness/controller.py](../harness/controller.py), [harness/server.py](../harness/server.py), [web/app.js](../web/app.js), [tests/test_controller.py](../tests/test_controller.py), [tests/test_server.py](../tests/test_server.py), [tests/test_viewer.cjs](../tests/test_viewer.cjs), [docs/protocol.md](../docs/protocol.md).

Coverage gap: Tests exercise fake-bridge and browser fixtures. Native takeover and engine input behavior need C-NATIVE. Pause cannot cancel an already-running activity; no structured damage/trap or combat guarantee.

### C-NATIVE — Native build and real-game acceptance (manual)

Changed native/input/rendering/protocol/compiler/source-pin behavior and new support claims. Follow native acceptance probes, inspect actual game/spectator frames and record dated outcomes, environment, candidate and hashes.

Owner: integration maintainer; lead verifies evidence. Trigger: relevant native boundary change or new native release/support claim.
Enforcement: Required by S-PROTOCOL/S-DELIVERY and release review; manual, outside the portable gate.
Failure response: Retain failed/unknown probes, block the affected claim and repair or document the supported limit.

Evidence / implementation: [docs/runbook.md#native-acceptance-lane](../docs/runbook.md#native-acceptance-lane), [docs/setup.md](../docs/setup.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp-manifest.json](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp-manifest.json).

Coverage gap: Historical MVP evidence is host/scenario specific; no automated native regression runner or current native execution is provided by this map. Ignored media may be unavailable on another checkout.

### C-USABILITY — Operator understanding review (manual)

Overview, navigation, control ownership, freshness, recovery limits and next decision. Review whether an operator can find purpose, current capabilities/limits, rationale, next change/tradeoffs and evidence from overview and immediate links; inspect ordinary and stale/paused/error flows when changed.

Owner: lead with operator feedback. Trigger: user-facing behavior/guidance change and milestone review.
Enforcement: Required review under S-UX/S-DOCS/S-WORK; no automatic usability gate.
Failure response: Correct misleading flows or guidance and retain consequential limits before milestone acceptance.

Evidence / implementation: [docs/overview.md](../docs/overview.md), [docs/changes/001-engineering-system.md](../docs/changes/001-engineering-system.md), [docs/runbook.md](../docs/runbook.md), [web/app.js](../web/app.js).

Coverage gap: Human judgment; no automated usability score or user study is claimed. Document links alone do not demonstrate comprehension.

### C-BOUNDARY — Architectural dependency contracts (automatic)

Declared controller and server dependency boundaries, including indirect imports through harness modules. Import Linter uses the pyproject.toml forbidden contracts: controller cannot depend on server, CLI, declared network modules or build tooling; server cannot depend on CLI/tools; CLI may compose both.

Owner: harness maintainer. Trigger: common command; architecture changes require rule review.
Enforcement: Common command runs the real lint-imports executable and propagates failure; temporary source fixtures exercise allowed composition and direct/indirect forbidden imports.
Failure response: Remove reversed dependency or review the boundary and checker together before accepting changed architecture.

Evidence / implementation: [pyproject.toml](../pyproject.toml), [tools/check.py](../tools/check.py), [tests/test_devtools.py](../tests/test_devtools.py), [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md), [docs/decisions/003-development-controls.md](../docs/decisions/003-development-controls.md).

Coverage gap: Static import graph with configured external roots. Dynamic imports, external-package internals, undeclared libraries and semantic C++ isolation remain review concerns; this is not comprehensive module layering.

### C-REVIEW — Design and independent change review (manual)

Consequential designs, implementation, tests, delegation and exceptions. Lead owns design/integration and verifies returned evidence; bounded workers have named paths; fresh-context review assesses contracts, risk and maintainability before checkpoint.

Owner: lead; reviewer supplies independent findings. Trigger: significant change, new boundary/guarantee/dependency or integration checkpoint.
Enforcement: Required under S-AGENT and change workflow; no automated approval or remote branch protection configured.
Failure response: Resolve material findings or record scoped owner/reason/revisit exception; after two unsuccessful worker repairs lead takes back the work.

Evidence / implementation: [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [docs/engineering.md](../docs/engineering.md), [docs/changes/001-engineering-system.md](../docs/changes/001-engineering-system.md), [docs/work.md](../docs/work.md).

Coverage gap: No code checker proves reasoning quality, typing completeness, decomposition or delegation compliance; independence depends on the actual review process.

### C-GOVERNANCE — Registry, evidence schema and map validation (automatic)

Mandatory standard mappings, principle/control IDs, local references, curated manifest metadata and generated map. jsonschema Draft 2020-12 with FormatChecker validates local record schemas. Bounded repository checks validate ID relationships, exact standard mappings, non-orphan references and contained evidence files, relative artifact references and generated output freshness.

Owner: maintainer. Trigger: common command; regenerate map after registry change.
Enforcement: Common command fails; negative tests exercise mapping/field/reference/drift failures. Normal mode never rewrites the map.
Failure response: Fix missing/unknown mappings, unsafe references or metadata; regenerate stale map with --write and inspect the result.

Evidence / implementation: [tools/governance.py](../tools/governance.py), [tests/test_governance.py](../tests/test_governance.py), [docs/control-registry.json](../docs/control-registry.json), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp-manifest.json](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp-manifest.json), [schemas/control-registry.schema.json](../schemas/control-registry.schema.json), [schemas/acceptance-manifest.schema.json](../schemas/acceptance-manifest.schema.json), [docs/decisions/003-development-controls.md](../docs/decisions/003-development-controls.md).

Coverage gap: Schemas and relationship checks validate structure and identity formats, not normative prose truth, artifact byte hashes, media availability, historical observations, owner performance or actual execution. Evidence fragments are not validated.

### C-PROTOCOL — Protocol v1 source agreement (automatic)

Native emitter/validator, controller send/validator, server advertisement and protocol document version. Recognize the current two C++ literal forms, Python AST dictionary/comparison literals and document version; require each to represent v1 exactly once.

Owner: bridge and controller maintainer. Trigger: common command; any protocol representation change requires checker review.
Enforcement: Common command fails on version drift or unrecognized source form; each representation has a negative fixture.
Failure response: Resolve version drift; for a refactor/version change review and update checker plus contract, then run required native acceptance.

Evidence / implementation: [tools/governance.py](../tools/governance.py), [tests/test_governance.py](../tests/test_governance.py), [native/cdda_harness.cpp](../native/cdda_harness.cpp), [harness/controller.py](../harness/controller.py), [harness/server.py](../harness/server.py), [docs/protocol.md](../docs/protocol.md).

Coverage gap: Narrow source drift detector, not a robust C++ parser or protocol conformance proof. Refactored representations fail for review; matching literals cannot prove runtime behavior.

### C-SETUP — Isolated pinned setup (runtime)

Explicit download/extract/build/install stages and checkout-owned temporary workspaces. Setup verifies checksums, extraction paths and build ownership; preserves existing app/environment, records local manifests and never launches the game automatically.

Owner: build maintainer. Trigger: each requested setup stage and dependency/compiler change.
Enforcement: Implemented stage guards plus portable setup regressions; native reproducibility requires C-NATIVE and manual provenance review.
Failure response: Stop failed stage, preserve diagnostics and retry only after identifying the corrupt input or owned workspace.

Evidence / implementation: [tools/setup.py](../tools/setup.py), [tools/prepare_game.py](../tools/prepare_game.py), [tools/patch_game.py](../tools/patch_game.py), [native/upstream.json](../native/upstream.json), [tests/test_setup.py](../tests/test_setup.py), [docs/setup.md](../docs/setup.md), [docs/environment.md](../docs/environment.md).

Coverage gap: Portable fixtures do not perform fresh downloads, native compilation/signing or install. Existing-host recipe is historical; broader hosts remain unverified.

### C-RELEASE — Exact candidate and evidence review (manual)

Checkpoint/release scope, source provenance and validation lanes. Inspect staged diff and candidate identity, run common checks against exact candidate, review pins/open exceptions and require relevant native probes for affected claims.

Owner: lead or releasing maintainer. Trigger: checkpoint, release or support claim.
Enforcement: Manual requirement; local hook and portable CI recipe support review but do not enforce release authority.
Failure response: Hold the affected acceptance/release claim until failed or unexecuted required lanes are resolved or scope is explicitly reduced.

Evidence / implementation: [docs/setup.md#evidence-and-releases](../docs/setup.md#evidence-and-releases), [docs/engineering.md](../docs/engineering.md), [docs/runbook.md#native-acceptance-lane](../docs/runbook.md#native-acceptance-lane), [native/upstream.json](../native/upstream.json).

Coverage gap: Working-tree hook does not prove a partially staged candidate; no tag, publication, remote required check or release automation is installed.

### C-MAINTENANCE — Drift, recovery and retention review (manual)

Active guidance, dependency/research freshness, failure evidence and project-owned cleanup. Review on behavior change/release/resumption and at least every 90 days during active development; record blockers/exceptions/lessons and check ownership/retention before cleanup.

Owner: maintainer; lead tracks active work. Trigger: behavior/control failure, release, resumed work or active-development review interval.
Enforcement: Required review under S-OPS/S-AGENT/S-DOCS/S-EVIDENCE; tracked through work and release review, outside portable gate.
Failure response: Record specific owner and next action, repair inaccurate guidance and preserve unresolved failures; never delete saves as routine cleanup.

Evidence / implementation: [docs/work.md](../docs/work.md), [docs/runbook.md](../docs/runbook.md), [docs/research-engineering.md](../docs/research-engineering.md), [docs/research.md](../docs/research.md), [docs/environment.md](../docs/environment.md).

Coverage gap: Manual policy with no scheduler, drift measurement or deletion job. No guarantee that elapsed review dates or storage availability are monitored automatically.

## Interpreting results

Run `.venv/bin/python tools/check.py` for the portable lane; update this map with
`.venv/bin/python tools/governance.py --write`. The latter validates before writing and
does not run gameplay. Dated executions belong in [acceptance](acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp.md)
and [work](work.md), with exact candidate, failures and unexecuted lanes.
